g.text: Finally found a use for all those gas cans you keep buying me.
I haven't bought you any gas cans.
Well, I had been just throwing them at the techrot, since they very much do not enjoy being on fire.
But it seems Velimir is a decent grill cook.
I need to go have *words* with our friend Amir.
Now that you both had your revenge with that horrific abomination at my expense.
The look on your face was incredible.
Once he stopped attempting to barbecue the techrot, that is...
Now I just need to convince him that trying to barbecue the techrot is a very bad idea...
Look, I still don't really know what they eat in - whenever you're from - but - I am going to judge you if you start eating *that.*
That was roughly the face I made, yes, exactly.
